## 4. Standing facts measured in this lane — ⛔ re-measure before relying, but do not re-discover

- 🔴 **The agent roster is fixed at SESSION CREATION.** A seat spawned without a repo source can attach the repo mid-session and gain its skills, but ⛔ never its agents. A successor must carry the repo in `session_context.sources` at creation and confirm `os-dev` before claiming. The confirming reading is an accepted `Agent` call.
- ⭐ **The account's 5-hour usage wall can stop every in-session subagent at once.** After the reset, each dev was resumed with `SendMessage` on its own context. ⛔ No order was re-run, and ⛔ no branch was re-cut. Read each dev's worktree and branch before trusting a resume note.
- **CI must be read latest-run-per-check-name** (`platform-readings.md`).
- ⭐ **A `check_run.completed` failure event can name a superseded head.** Read the PR's current head before diagnosing.
- **`mergeable_state: blocked` right after a ready-flip is a transient.** Queue entry typically follows within 2–5 minutes.
- ⭐ **The CI job-log download is refused from this container** (403 from the blob host). MCP `get_job_logs` reads it.
- ⭐ **The footer behaviour of a body write depends on the CHANNEL.** The fleet relay's `issue_patch` stores a body VERBATIM. Send the footer you want stored, and read back after every write.
- ⭐ **`post-stamped` enforces the stamp contract.** A body carrying `{{NOW}}` refuses any other bare stamp; write a quoted instant as `{{WAS:…}}`. A backticked token is left verbatim. It also refuses a `Thread-read:` line with anything after its value.
- ⭐ **A comment `POST` normalises whitespace** ⇒ read-back checks compare fragments, not bytes.
- **The REST `/search/*` path is refused in this container.** Dedupe searches run through the MCP `search_issues` READ tool, with a positive control. ⛔ It is never a write channel.
- ⭐ **MCP `search_issues` is semantic and can lag or go blank.** For lane and label reads use `list_issues` with `labels:` and compare against `totalCount`; ⛔ MCP `list_issues` with two labels is a UNION, not an intersection (re-measured at this seating: `pm:queue` + `domain:services` returned 26 cards spanning other lanes). Read the lane with one label and intersect locally.
- **`ccr/auto_merge` echoes `merge_method` back wrongly, and right after queue entry `auto_merge` can read null or false** ⇒ the landing criterion is the timeline's `added_to_merge_queue` and delivery on `origin/main`, ⛔ never the PR-closed event.
- **A closing keyword does NOT clean the board.** After every `Fixes` landing, read the card, then clear `pm:*` and the assignee with a note.
- ⭐ **Auto-merge can sit un-queued** with an idle queue. One relay `automerge_disable` + `automerge_enable` pair queues it at once.
- ⭐ **`scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` needs `--repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`** with `--actions-file`.
- ⭐ **This session cannot write to `objectstack-ai/cloud`.** A cloud follow-up goes to the `repo:cloud` seat on its post (#6026).
- ⭐ **A dev's public report can carry a security reproduction.** Read every report and PR body for disclosure **before** anything else.
- ⭐ **Whole-machine restarts come under parallel heavy dev work.** Every order puts every build, test run, typecheck and gate run under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.
- ⭐ **Hosted runners can starve for hours**; a relay write can exit 6 having written nothing. Read the run and the target before a resend.
- ⭐ **`issue-create` can report UNVERIFIED although the issue exists.** Read the board; ⛔ never retry blind.
- **`check-expected-skips.mjs` / `check-half-states.mjs` will not run without `pnpm install`** (`yaml` not found). The shared checkout has no `node_modules` at this seating; `post-stamped`, `label-write`, `dispatch-gates`, `git-history` and `check-harness-current` run without it (self-tests green at seating).
- **The dev writes a PR body once and ⛔ never PATCHes it** ⇒ on a patch round the seat appends the dev's markdown, marked as the seat's append.
- ⭐ **`git-history.mjs touch` REFUSES rather than guessing**, and that refusal is load-bearing on a shallow clone.
- ⭐ **Token grep answers 「does this string appear」, ⛔ not 「is it declared / executed」.**
- **Publication layer for this repo:** a merge to `main` does ⛔ not publish ⇒ the landing criterion is MERGED, except a fix whose consumer is another repo, judged on installability (objectui pins by `.objectstack-sha`; #24665's unlock for objectui#12484 is the pin bump, not the close).
- ⛔ **`cloud` and `hotcrm` are not reachable from this session.** `objectstack-ai/objectui` is readable, and the fleet relay writes to it.
- ⭐ **The contract-review tier constant** is `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` in `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (read it there). `dispatch-gates --tier` says a card that only narrows owes one such review before the queue. `contract-review.md` scopes the owed review by face.
- ⭐ **Merge-queue timing:** `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` via the relay → `added_to_merge_queue` about 2 minutes later → merged about 30 minutes after entry.
- ⭐ **A merge-queue kick can be infrastructure** (artifact upload `ETIMEDOUT`); the merge-queue-triage comment arrives only after the whole queue run concludes.

- ⭐ **`post-stamped` refuses an all-quoted stamp:** a claim whose only stamp sits inside a code span is refused, nothing written. Put `{{NOW}}` on the opening line (`Claim: PM loop round N · ` then the token). It also refuses a body rewrite whose opening line carries another act's stamp (a director `Ruled:` line): add the new line ABOVE and keep `Ruled:` verbatim beneath (measured on #24646).
- ⭐ **Write order for a claim:** post the `Claim:` comment first, then the label pair. Labels first and a refused comment leave a live half-state (measured on #24709, closed within the minute).
- ⭐ **A cloud session spawned by `create_session` carries no `mcp__github__*` tools.** Its dev reads and writes through REST and the fleet relay; the report arrives as an `os-dev-report` comment on the card. `get_session`'s `task_summary` is the cheap liveness reading.
- ⭐ **`governedPathsIn` (`scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`) takes the register id (`objectstack`, `objectui`, …), ⛔ not the `owner/name` slug:** a slug is refused, never answered as clear. Measured at PR #24732's review.
- ⭐ **A console check that needs no objectui code can be measured by a read-only static subagent over `/home/user/objectui`:** PR #24732's Add / Remove and invite-placement readings came from one, cited file:line in the ACCEPT.
- ⭐ **A PR that corrects a PENDING release note it made false turns `Check Changeset` red by design** (`check-empty-changeset.mjs`, the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class; only that one step fails). `pr-automation.yml` runs on `pull_request` only, so SKILL.md's three-condition rule lets the seat carry the red into the queue with the gate and the reason in its ACCEPT (measured on PR #24761).
- ⭐ **A security reproduction a dev reports goes to the seat by private channel** (`SendMessage` to the dev, the reply kept in this session's scratchpad), and the filed card stays abstract. The fix dev gets the reproduction in its dispatch order (measured with #24746).
- ⭐ **`check_suite.completed` on a subscribed PR is a wake, never a release reading:** read the check-runs on the head and trial-merge before the relay flip. A `git merge-tree` trial needs the PR head fetched into a NAMED ref: `FETCH_HEAD` after a two-ref fetch is the first ref, and merging main with itself reads clean (measured here).
